theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (g : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ V : ValuationSubring E, V.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ V.IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ ∧ ∀ g' : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, V.IsFrobeniusAt g' ℓ → g' = g
